Inline actuator or column (ratio 1).name: Inline actuator or column (ratio 1)
Inline actuator or column (ratio 1).note: Needs a retracted length of about stroke + body length; does not fit under the seat, so it would sit beside the seat (e.g. inside the side-rail post) and carry the seat as a cantilever.

design_notes: Space under the seat (collapsed) is about 0.30 m; an inline actuator needs about stroke + 0.10-0.20 m = 0.34-0.44 m, so it does not fit under the seat.
A scissor fits (collapsed about 0.13 m) but multiplies the actuator force by about 2.7-3.9 near the flush position.
Let the seat rest on a mechanical end stop when flush, so the actuator only ever pushes up to the force cap at the start of a lift.
With the admittance rule the actuator never pushes more than F_cap x ratio; holding loads at height are 0.6-1.3 x the seat load.
